title: Kamishiro Rui — A Director's Meticulous Magic〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Around here should work.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This seems like a good place to test Robo-Dog's new features. There's plenty of space and nobody else here...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, we can try out...
Aha, here you are.
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene, Robo-Nene.
What a coincidence. Fancy seeing you both here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not a coincidence. We've been looking for you. Remember how you said that you'd do maintenance on Robo-Nene today?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I went over to your house, and your mom told me that you were at the park...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: How could you leave me behind like that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, my apologies. I was under the impression that you two would be by later this evening.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's fine and all... But what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Testing out Robo-Dog's new features.
Would you two be so kind as to stay and watch?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: New features?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Remember how I helped out with your reading event the other day?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After reading the story, a few ideas popped into my head.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Some shows have a dog as the protagonist, just like that book. I thought it'd be fun if I gave Robo-Dog a wide array of features and functions to use in such cases.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
For Robo-Dog...?
What exactly did you do to him?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, I made him more acrobatic.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He already had the ability to perform a few tricks, but I made him much more robust so that he can handle more daring stunts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, Robo-Dog, jump.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa! He just jumped like three meters into the air...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Excellent. He even stuck the landing as calculated.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But being able to jump three meters seems kinda excessive...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Not true.
We're always striving to astound the audience, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, dodging an enemy's attack could be accomplished with a simple movement. But performing this sort of stunt would be much more impressive, would it not?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Grr...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I even installed a dance function.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Dancing is an integral part of musicals, and I doubt you'd be able to take your eyes off of a dancing dog.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, he can dance...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright, Robo-Dog.
Show these two your moves.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
He's standing on his hind legs!
He's really dancing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. A dog dancing on all four legs wouldn't surprise anyone. He'll need to be able to do at least this to blow away an audience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'd be surprised, alright...
Actually, it feels a little too human for its own good...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Grrr...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I am better than him!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Uhh... Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is she trying to show up Robo-Dog?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Does this mean she's jealous of him...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think she wants you to give her more attention after hearing you go on and on about Robo-Dog.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
I apologize for not noticing sooner.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I can also dance! Better than him to say the least!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Robo-Nene.
It's clear that you are the better dancer.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: As long as you understand!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and I hope you're not getting the wrong idea about what I just said.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Robo-Dog still requires quite a bit of work.
You are still my greatest robotic creation, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When I do perform maintenance on you, I might take that opportunity to install a few new things.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's fine, but nothing weird, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I know.
Anyway, shall we?
